KEYSTONE STEEL & ALLOYS REPORTS Q1 FISCAL 2026 RESULTS

Keystone Steel & Alloys (NASDAQ: KSTA) today announced financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 2026. Revenue was $2,130.0 million, down 13.2% year over year. GAAP net income was $47.0 million, or $0.48 per diluted share. Non-GAAP net income was $102.4 million, or $1.06 per diluted share. Results include a $66.0 million plant closure costs (charge), which is excluded from non-GAAP measures along with stock-based compensation of $6.0 million. For fiscal 2026, the company expects revenue of $8,200.0 million to $8,600.0 million on a GAAP basis.

Condensed income statement (in millions, unaudited)
  Revenue                       $2,130.0 million
  Cost of revenue               $1,861.0 million
  Gross profit                  $269.0 million
  Operating expenses            $208.0 million (incl. $66.0 million of items noted above)
  Operating income (loss)       $61.0 million
  Income tax expense            $14.0 million
  Net income (loss)             $47.0 million
  Diluted shares (millions)     97.0

Prior-year quarter: revenue $2,455.0 million; operating income $310.0 million.
